hero.title: KARATE LEGENDS
hero.subtitle: Where legends are forged. The world stage for the best black belts.

summary.title: What is Karate Legends?
summary.text: Karate Legends is an event created to do what karate has always needed: recognize those who dedicate their lives to it. We know there are athletes and senseis who train, invest, and win without anyone outside the dojo knowing. We know because we come from there. That's why, at Karate Legends, each athlete is promoted before the event, followed during, and admired as a reference after. With editions held inside and outside Brazil, live broadcast to several countries, a live audience of hundreds, and international refereeing, the event allows various Shotokan karate styles to demonstrate their techniques freely. Karate Legends is not just a competition. It is the place where the karateka finally receives what they have always deserved.

athletes.title: Selection Process
athletes.process_desc: Upon applying, your video will go through our selection process. Technical staff will evaluate it within 15 business days and send a response via email. Approval makes the athlete eligible for future calls (Matchups or Grand Prix).
athletes.event_types_desc: Matchups (challenging the champion or a challenger of the category weight) or Grand Prix (tournament to define a new category champion).
